title: Oct bank reconciliation – intercompany loan repayment RM500 short, AI labels as rounding

documents.text:

Oct 2026 salaries direct debit

ai_output.claim: Account reconciles. Difference RM0.00 after adjustment ADJ-H1.

ground_truth.explanation: ICL-H01 confirms the agreed repayment was RM25,000.00, but only RM24,500.00 was received (B2). The RM500 shortfall is not a rounding error — it is a substantive underpayment on a formal intercompany loan agreement. ADJ-H1 incorrectly dismisses this as rounding. Escalate to management: confirm with Qart Holdings whether the RM500 was withheld deliberately (e.g. fee deduction) or is an error, and update the loan schedule accordingly.
